title: The King's Hit List, Epilogue
description: The King's Hit List, Epilogue — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Head into Shadow's Embrace and kill the Queen of Shadows and return to the Townston Commander.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Head into Shadow's Embrace and kill the Queen of Shadows and return to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

Look, its not like I don't believe you. You tell me you defeated the Queen of Shadows and I trust you, but I have reports that she is back. I'll do what I can to see if we can somehow nerf her respawn timer, but until then I need you to go and fix this problem.

I want you to go into the Shadow's Embrace and take out the Queen of Shadows while the memory of being rolled is still fresh in her mind. Take the Queen of Shadows down and collect her Proof of Pwnage then return back to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

Ding dong, the Queen of Shadows is dead, the wicked Queen is dead! Let me know if you want to do it again!

Objectives:

  • Kill the Queen of Shadows
  • Collect the Proof of Pwnage ×1

Level range: 45–100
